limitations: Its products are elastomers whose makers do not disclose which, so its range spans several elastomers, and heat deflection does not apply to it.

summary.text: TPE, maker-undisclosed elastomer is a thermoplastic elastomer whose makers do not name the elastomer. A maker sells its oyster-shell-based composite for flexible projects in everyday use and calls it compostable. On the H2C it prints at 220⁠–⁠230 °C, and drying is optional, at 50⁠–⁠60 °C for 4 h.

identityNote: The home of elastomer products whose makers do not disclose which, after a search of their safety data sheets, product pages, guides, archived editions and listings. Shown and judged like any material, but not estimated: no document here names its polymer, so the estimate model cannot place it. Made as a "polymer not stated" home and renamed by the owner's instruction of (D106). A product a document names is filed under that polymer's material instead; the owner files one on the best evidence where the documents fall short, and says so on the grade (R205).

notApplicable.hdt045: HDT is a rigid-bar test. ISO 75 ends at 0.2 % outer-fibre strain, which a bar reaches once its modulus falls to about 225 MPa, so an elastomer has no meaningful HDT and makers list it as N/A. A value an elastomer's sheet publishes is shown and never decides. Sintering filaments are left out too: the finished part is the sintered metal or ceramic.

items.text: Nanovia TPE 22D is a flexible filament of a shore hardness 22D / 70A that makes it possible to 3D print shock and vibration absorbers.
Easy to print, this material largely used for industrial shock and vibration absorption, as well as parts that need to deform dramatically.
Great flexibility
Shock resistant
Due to its softness, it is not possible to sand Nanovia TPE 22D.
It has particularly strong inter lays adhesion and wear resistance.
Nanovia TPE 22D allows for the creation of flexible parts, with excellent inter-layer adhésion.
Great inter-layer adhesion
Store in airtight container with desiccant, out of direct sunlight.
Dehydrate for 4h at 50°C prior to printing after prolonged exposure to humidity.
We recommend printing Nanovia TPE 22D in a room equipped with air extraction or by using appropriate breathing equipment.
Due to its flexible nature, a direct drive extruder is recommended.
There should be little to no tension between the spool and the extruder to prevent the permanent stretching of the filament, which can cause under extrusion.

items.text: Its semi-rigid base, allows for structural components, still able to deform when necessary and absorb shocks. This combination makes Nanovia Flex B4C particularly suited for tools, maintenance equipment, and transport vessels for fragile materials.

products.name: Nanovia ISTROFLEX
products.composition: "Modified Polyester alloy and oyster shell powder" (R-NANOVIA-ISTROFLEX-SDS, p. 1); "a heavy polymer, based on biodegradable monomers and cosmetic grade oyster shells" (R-NANOVIA-ISTROFLEX, as printed). A compostable polyester alloy with a glass transition of -32 °C (its safety data sheet) and a Vicat of 91 °C, PBAT's kind by those figures; Nanovia names no polymer, and it stays in the maker-undisclosed elastomer home as the rubber it is, Shore 44D / 93A (the owner's rulings, 2026-10-20, R232, D176). Its density, 1.55 g/cm³ on the page and 1.34 on the safety data sheet, is above an unfilled elastomer's: the oyster-shell load is a declared dense filler (D57, R095).
products.certifications: Endocrine pertubatur free certified (p. 1: Advantages, with laboratory reference below; maker claim; linked certificate/laboratory report not retrieved or reread in this campaign; no certification pass or service qualification)

items.text: Using Nanovia Istroflex, biodegradable oyster shell based composite 3D filament, 3D print every day use flexible projects.

Its flexibillity is perfectly suited for technical parts that require a certain amount of give or bounce such as shock and vibration absorbers, silent blocks, gaskets, interstitial constricted materials, etc…
Compostable according to norm EN 13432, this filament is certified without endocrine disruptors.
Biodegradable and compostable
Endocrine pertubatur free certified
Nanovia Istroflex is characterized by a very good build plate and inter layer adhesion.
Excellent inter layer adhesion
Store in airtight container with desiccant, out of direct sunlight.
Dehydrate for 4h at 60°C prior to printing after prolonged exposure to humidity.
For a bettter print result, a lower retraction speed is recommended.
It is possible to sand thick layers of Nanovia Istroflex.
